systems.system: Population register (furnishing of information under section 21(2) of the Identification Act)
systems.tiers: national; from 1 July 2025 information is furnished at R10 per real-time transaction and R1 per batch field, and at no fee to any State department, municipality or statutory body

note: A regulation setting fees for information from the population register; it exempts municipalities from the fee and does not say that any municipality draws on the register or how its offices are connected.
